open_questions.question: Can an authorized runtime/session export identify the SDK build, selected model, backend revision, effective settings, and stable task ID?

proposed_probe.purpose: Establish identity and pinning evidence without running a benchmark.
proposed_probe.inputs: A new, explicitly authorized session in a clean non-production workspace; no repository code or secrets.
proposed_probe.expected_evidence: Version/build metadata, requested model label and settings, backend/revision fields if provided, and an explicit statement of missing fields.
proposed_probe.proposed_cap: One user prompt/task, 5-minute wall-clock timeout, no additional tool-created agent tasks; proceed only with a human-approved provider usage cap and stop criteria.
proposed_probe.approval: Human approval required before any new model/cloud run; no run was performed for this discovery.

open_questions.question: Can raw usage and event telemetry be exported with request IDs, input/output/cache/reasoning token categories, child calls, tools, timestamps, retries, errors, and deduplication semantics?

proposed_probe.purpose: Determine whether a minimal session has complete attributable usage lineage.
proposed_probe.inputs: Prefer an authorized existing-session export; only if unavailable, one separately approved low-impact session with no code-generation task.
proposed_probe.expected_evidence: Redacted schema/sample showing nullable fields, aggregation semantics, event ordering, and documented export/retention policy.
proposed_probe.proposed_cap: No second cloud/model run without human approval and a provider-enforced usage cap; preserve USD as unknown if no authoritative charge record.
proposed_probe.approval: Human and account owner approval required for usage/billing exports or any new run.

open_questions.question: Can the exact surface support isolated, repeatable H0-H3 executions, including automatically loading fixed guidelines, enforcing H2 limits, and invoking native Loom?

proposed_probe.purpose: Validate exposure and enforcement rather than infer them from file/tool availability.
proposed_probe.inputs: A clean non-production repo copy, frozen common prompt, distinct no-op sentinel per profile, documented model/runtime config, and external timeout/usage controller.
proposed_probe.expected_evidence: Per-profile effective-input manifest, model/runtime identity, observable orchestration trace, changed-file snapshot, stop behavior, and complete cost/usage export.
proposed_probe.proposed_cap: At most one user task per H0-H3 profile, 10 minutes per task, no retries or follow-ups; do not start until human approval and a verifiable account-level usage cap are in place.
proposed_probe.approval: Human approval required. If fixed model/runtime identity, isolation, or billing cap cannot be enforced, do not treat the results as a controlled comparison.
